description:
Straight Tension Fabric Display: Low effort, big on impact.

Banners are a staple for any kind of exhibit. With your logo front and center, it’s easy to catch people’s attention and turn them into customers.

Banners for trade shows need to look crisp and clean always—whether it’s the first use or the tenth use. With a straight tension fabric display, your brand stays eye-catching and visible.

These banners are easy to set up, too. Insert the fabric into the frame, pull it taut, and it’s ready to go. If there are wrinkles on the fabric, you can use a hand steamer to smoothen out the creases.

Custom-Printed Graphics

Our straight tension fabric banners come in two parts: frame and graphic. Choose from the two sizes below:

Display Size

The graphic is printed on an 8.8 oz. tension fabric that minimizes light reflection. The closely woven threads result in colored and vibrant prints that are eye-catching both near and far.

Highlight your logo with the two optional LED lights. The straight tension fabric banners will be shipped to you inside the carrying case of your choice. Choose between a soft canvas bag and a hard case.
